stemMd: Hydrogen reacts with oxygen according to 2 H2 + O2 → 2 H2O. If 5 mol H2 and 2 mol O2 react completely as far as possible, how many moles of water form?
explanationMd: Two moles of oxygen require four moles of hydrogen and produce four moles of water. Oxygen is limiting; one mole of hydrogen remains. Always compare reactants using the balanced ratio.

distractorRationale.a: This ignores the coefficient of water.
distractorRationale.c: There is insufficient oxygen to consume all hydrogen.
distractorRationale.d: Reactant mole totals cannot be simply added.
distractorRationale.e: This doubles hydrogen without checking the limiting reagent.
